entities.summary: Maria von Wedemeyer Weller was an American computer scientist, who emigrated from Germany to the US after the Second World War. She was known in the field of computer science for her role in developing emulation capability. She was also notable as having been the fiancée of the German Protestant theologian and Resistance worker Dietrich Bonhoeffer.
